Bacterial_Spot.description: Bacterial infection causing dark, water-soaked spots.
Bacterial_Spot.recommendation: Apply copper-based sprays; avoid overhead watering.

Early_Blight.description: Fungal disease causing brown rings on lower leaves.

Late_blight.description: Serious fungal disease causing large brown lesions.

Leaf_Mold.description: Fungus causing pale green or yellow spots.

Target_Spot.description: Fungal disease causing target-like lesions on leaves.
Target_Spot.recommendation: Improve airflow; use fungicides if severe.

black_spot.description: Fungal disease causing black spots with fringed edges.
black_spot.recommendation: Remove diseased leaves; use fungicidal spray.
